description: Public metadata for a Loom video from Loom's oEmbed API: title, description, duration in seconds, size, thumbnail and embed URL. Metadata only: it does not download or return the video file. Works only for videos the owner made public or anyone-with-link. Related tools on this server, for a different need: media_openverse when you need Openverse openly licensed image search: title, creator; media_podchaser when you need Podcast search across the Apple Podcasts directory: podcast. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: Loom share or embed link: https://www.loom.com/share/<32-character id>
